description: This file is a shell script for the IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel backend configuration in OpenWRT, defining functions for setting up, tearing down, and initializing tunnel configurations, with commands to manipulate network interfaces and routing via external tools.

methods.name: proto_map_setup
methods.description: Sets up IPv4-in-IPv6 tunnel based on configuration variables, including defining routing, tunnels, and firewall rules.

methods.name: proto_map_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the configured tunnel, removing routes and managing control mechanisms.

methods.name: proto_map_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration parameters for the mapping protocol, defining expected configuration variables.
